newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Goncz to speak about NATO at Prague democracy forum.
newsitem.headline: Goncz to speak about NATO at Prague democracy forum.

text.p: Hungarian President Arpad Goncz will visit Prague on Saturday to address a U.S.-sponsored symposium on democracy and market economics, Radio Free Europe-Radio Liberty said on Tuesday.
In his address at Prague's Charles University, Goncz will speak about Hungary's plans to join NATO, they said in a statement.
The speech will conclude a three-week symposium for more than 100 students from 22 central and eastern European countries and the United States.
Before the address, Goncz is to visit Radio Free Europe-Radio Liberty headquarters in Prague where he will hold a news conference.

Czech President Vaclav Havel's office said on Tuesday that there were no plans for Havel to meet his Hungarian counterpart during the visit to Prague. Havel has been on holiday at his cottage in northeastern Bohemia.

The symposium, under the auspices of the American Institute on Political and Economic Systems, is sponsored by the non-profit Fund for American Studies, Washington's Georgetown University, and Charles University.
